# SlotUrSelf

> SlotUrSelf is an enterprise healthcare appointment platform that enables real-time, verified clinical booking with zero wait times.

## Overview
SlotUrSelf connects patients directly to verified healthcare providers across partner hospital networks and independent clinics. The platform features atomic slot-locking to eliminate double-booking, AI-assisted preliminary symptom triage, and location-based specialist routing.

## Core Capabilities
- **Real-Time Booking Engine**: Master clinical calendar integration providing instant slot locks.
- **Verified Medical Professionals**: All medical practitioners undergo credential and medical licensing checks.
- **Specialist Routing & AI Triage**: Structured symptom analysis mapping clinical presentation to appropriate medical departments.
- **Digital Passes**: QR-coded tickets and countdown arrival passes to bypass physical clinic queues.
- **Emergency Helpline**: National Medical Emergency routing (108).

## Medical Specialties Supported
- Cardiology (Heart, Cardiovascular, Hypertension)
- Neurology (Brain, Migraines, Neuropathy)
- Orthopedics (Bone, Joints, Spine, Sports Injuries)
- Ophthalmology (Eye Care, Cataracts, Vision Correction)
- Dentistry (Oral Health, Preventive & Restorative Care)
- General Practice (Primary Care, Family Medicine, Preventive Health)
